{{Quote|We dueled on Dantooine. Fought for three days. I won when I convinced him to abandon the dark side and train as a Jedi.|Tol Braga|<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" />}}
During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tol Braga]] corresponded regularly with various [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] as he sought a way to bring the conflict to a peaceful close. However, the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor's]] efforts were unsuccessful until [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Sajar]], a member of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] ruling [[Dark Council]], asked to meet him<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> to discuss peace.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Their meeting occurred sometime between [[3678 BBY]] and the end of the war in [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Date" /> Sajar '''attacked''' the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] when he arrived, beginning a duel that would last for three [[Standard day/Legends|days]] as the two debated and attempted to draw their opponent over to their respective side of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The duel ended when Braga successfully convinced the Dark Councilor to abandon the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and become his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learner. Shedding his title of Darth, Sajar shared much of his knowledge with the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]],<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> including information on the agents known as the [[Children of the Emperor|Children]] of the [[Tenebrae|Emperor]].<ref name="The Defector">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Defector|the Abandoned Mining Facility}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The duel was first mentioned by Tol Braga in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]]. During the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class mission "The Emperor's Wrath," Braga explains his history with Sajar before sending the player to [[Quesh]].<ref name="The Emperor's Wrath" /> The [[2012]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' gave more information about the duel, though it incorrectly placed it on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
